text:
incident-bot: PAGER → multiple GPU OOMs observed during prefill on redwood-east-1 serving pool. service=runtime-serving severity=P1. spike started ~2147489950 UTC. Auto-retries causing container restarts.

oncall-eng: Acknowledged. Investigating. Which model family / context sizes?

sre-core: Seeing long-context jobs (>= 120k tokens) and a burst of prefills from a single customer. Kernel log shows repeated 'cudaErrorIllegalAddress' followed by container restart.

alice-ml: Confirmed it's large-window requests hitting kvcache allocation. Model: llama-70b-q4; sequence len spikes to ~1.2e5 tokens during prefill.

ben-cust-succ: Customer "NimbleDocs" reported ~500 failed requests and timeouts; they expect SLA note. They hit the app around 11:23 local (~2147489955).

oncall-eng: Throttling incoming prefill requests for that customer now (rate-limit route). Applying quick policy: max_prefill_tokens=32768 for their tenant.

infra-bot: Executed: /scripts/route-qos set-tenant-limits --tenant nimbledocs --max-prefill 32768 --reason "live mitigation"

sre-core: Also enabling eviction-based drop for very long prefills: kvcache.eviction_policy=aggressive on pool redwood-east-1-serving-2. Will monitor.

oncall-eng: Rolling a hotpatch to fallback to smaller model variant (llama-70b -> llama-13b-quant) for requests that exceed 65k tokens. Patch ID: hp-214748-01.

alice-ml: Recommend adding prefix-cache trimming before fallback to preserve user experience. Pushing a short-lived config: prefill_trim_window=32k.

jordan: Customer comms drafted: "We saw increased failures earlier due to very large context prefill; we throttled and applied fallbacks — service impact mitigated. Engineering continues root cause and long-term fix." — want approval to send.

ben-cust-succ: Approved. Send now and include mitigation steps and ETA for RCA (4h).

sre-core: Early root-cause notes: allocation path for kvcache + fragmented GPU mem leads to illegal address when prefill attempts to allocate contiguous KV for huge sequence. Short-term mitigations applied: tenant-level token cap, eviction, model fallback.

oncall-eng: Handoff to night oncall (jordan) in 20m. Please watch for recurring OOMs or noisy-neighbor increases.

jordan: Taking handoff. I'll paste watch commands and alert filters into #eng-oncall docs.

incident-bot: LOGS: ```
[2147489960] runtime-serving: prefill start tenant=nimbledocs seq_len=121457
[2147489961] runtime-serving: kvcache_alloc size=9.6GiB -> cudaErrorIllegalAddress
[2147489962] runtime-serving: container restart triggered (exit 137)
```

sre-core: Follow-ups for RCA/next day: 1) investigate allocation fragmentation and contiguous KV allocation strategy, 2) add prefill soft-fails with graceful degradation, 3) improve tenant-level throttles and default caps.

oncall-eng: Replacing immediate pager routing to avoid repeated restarts; marking incident as in-mitigation. Will update status page if customer impact persists.

ben-cust-succ: Notifying affected customers timeline + link to status update.

jordan: Handed off. Monitoring dashboards and logs, will escalate if OOMs resume.

incident-bot: Incident state=mitigated (live mitigations active). Escalation: reopen if >3 restarts in 15m for same pool.
